title: Your number: link state and yearly confirmation
summary: The state of the person's linked phone number in Configurações → Privacidade → Seu número, and the one in-app notice before the yearly confirmation runs out (bipe-chat/bipe#470, bipe/docs/phone-link.md). A linked number stays findable for linkConfirmMonths after its last proof; after that, lookup skips it until the person confirms it again.

kind.description: notLinked: GET /v1/me/phone linked false. linked: confirm_by is more than linkConfirmWarnDays away. confirmSoon: confirm_by is within linkConfirmWarnDays. expired: confirm_by has passed.

confirmBy.description: confirm_by from GET /v1/me/phone. Shown with the system date formatter, date only.

direction.description: out: another account proved this number. in: this account proved a number another account holds.

ends.description: When a waiting move ends. Shown date only.

number.description: number from GET /v1/me/phone, the person's own linked number in E.164, formatted with displayPhone (registries/phone-numbers.json). null when not linked or for a link made before ADR 0191.

move.description: move from GET /v1/me/phone (bipe-chat/bipe#469). A banner on the Privacidade group shows it. It never names the other account.

noticeShown.description: true when the confirmSoon or expired notice for this confirm_by was shown on this phone.

appear.effect: Reads GET /v1/me/phone and sets phone. The privacy row number shows the value: bipe_privacy_number_not_linked, bipe_phone_linked_until (linked), bipe_phone_confirm_soon (confirmSoon, with the caution colour and the warning mark) or bipe_phone_confirm_expired (expired, same colour and mark). With a number, the value is bipe_privacy_number_value (%1$s the formatted number, %2$s that state text).

checkNotice.effect: On launch and on foreground, for each signed-in account: when phone is confirmSoon or expired and no notice was shown for this confirm_by, shows one notice (bipe_phone_confirm_notice_title with bipe_phone_confirm_soon or bipe_phone_confirm_expired) and keeps that confirm_by as shown. One notice per confirm_by, never again.

blockMove.effect: Only with direction out and state waiting. POST /v1/me/phone/moves/{id}/block, then reads GET /v1/me/phone again. A failure shows bipe_phone_move_block_failed.

confirm.effect: Hidden until bipe-chat/bipe#63 ships the SMS proof (gate planned:63). Then: runs the same proof as the link, and the API sets confirmed_at to now. A confirmation of the same number never starts a move (bipe-chat/bipe#469).

notes: Thresholds: linkConfirmMonths and linkConfirmWarnDays in registries/phone-numbers.json. The API uses linkConfirmMonths for lookup and for confirm_by; the apps use linkConfirmWarnDays. Same copy and same thresholds on both apps.
Links made by staff with the admin CLI (method admin) follow the same rule: confirmed_at is the time of the link.

Own number (ADR 0191, bipe-chat/bipe#787): GET /v1/me/phone returns the caller's own number, and only there. The server keeps it encrypted. A link made before ADR 0191 has no stored number: the row shows the state only. Formatting: displayPhone (registries/phone-numbers.json display, test-vectors/phone-numbers.json display); Bipe logic BipePhoneNumber.display (BipeKit, libraries/bipe).

Move banner: direction out and state waiting shows bipe_phone_move_out with ends and the bipe_phone_move_block button. Direction in shows bipe_phone_move_in with ends, or bipe_phone_move_blocked for state blocked. Dates use the same date-only formatter as confirmBy. The server also sends a notice in the support room (moveHoldDays in registries/phone-numbers.json).
